title: StockIQ sandbox API
purpose: Self-contained draft endpoints for synthetic workflow testing. This is not the production StockIQ API contract.
base_url: Same origin as the draft website. Use relative /api/... paths only.
network_rules: All browser API calls must stay on the draft origin.
No arbitrary API base URL, production API proxy, supplier API, PMR feed or credential forwarding is supported.
Do not send production credentials, patient data or branch identifiers.

workspace.initialization: POST /api/workspaces with a client-generated id; include that id in the header of later requests.
workspace.storage: Process-local, ephemeral memory; clients may restore a validated snapshot using POST /api/workspaces. Workspaces may be lost on worker restart, isolate change or eviction.
workspace.security: The workspace id is a demo isolation key, not production authentication or authorization. This server must not be connected to sensitive or live data.

success.workspace: Current workspace snapshot on workspace-scoped responses; also returned on creation and reset.

error.code: Optional machine-readable code. SESSION_EXPIRED means create or restore the workspace before retrying.

validation.quantities: Whole numbers from 1 through 999 unless an endpoint states a different range.

common_errors.400: Malformed JSON, invalid field, empty basket or invalid quantity.
common_errors.409: Workspace not initialized, already received order or record capacity reached.

endpoints.description: Reports sandbox status and zero supplier connections. No workspace header required.
Creates or restores an isolated synthetic workspace. No workspace header required.

request_body.workspace: Optional version-1 snapshot returned by an earlier response; omit to seed test data.

notes: id must be 8–80 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
Existing id reuses its in-memory workspace when no snapshot is supplied.
A snapshot is validated and normalized against the synthetic catalog before restoration.

endpoints.description: Replaces this workspace with freshly seeded test data.
Lists the synthetic product catalog.

query_parameters.q: Optional case-insensitive name or PIP substring.
query_parameters.category: Optional Prescription or OTC filter, case-insensitive.
query_parameters.fast: Set to the string true to return fast lines only.

endpoints.description: Returns low-stock or owed sample products with suggested quantities.
Returns basket items, total and total pack quantity.
Adds a product and increments an existing basket line.
notes: Resulting line quantity must remain in the range 1–999.

endpoints.description: Sets the quantity of an existing basket line.
Removes an existing basket line.
Lists test orders.

query_parameters.status: Optional exact status: Awaiting, Part received or Received.

endpoints.description: Creates a test order from the current basket and empties the basket.
notes: The basket must contain at least one product.
supplier is optional and defaults to preferredSupplier.
source is auto or manual; unknown values use manual.
No external order or supplier connection is created.

endpoints.description: Receives test packs into synthetic stock and settles synthetic owed quantities.
notes: Omit items to receive all outstanding quantities.
An explicit items array must contain at least one unique ordered product.
Quantities are additional packs received and cannot exceed the outstanding amount.
Returns 409 for a fully received order. Receipt validation happens before any line is changed.

endpoints.description: Records an isolated test claim.
notes: Reason is required, up to 500 characters.
quantity defaults to 1 and cannot exceed the total ordered pack quantity.
No supplier receives this claim.

endpoints.description: Lists saved sandbox baskets.
Saves a copy of the current basket as a draft without clearing the basket.
notes: Name is required, up to 80 characters; basket must be nonempty.

endpoints.description: Replaces the current basket with a saved draft using current synthetic catalog prices.
Deletes a saved sandbox draft.
Lists sandbox claims.
Marks a sandbox claim Resolved.
Lists sandbox stock feedback.
Records product feedback locally in the test workspace.
notes: Message is required, up to 500 characters.

endpoints.description: Sets the synthetic stock-on-shelf count.
notes: Stock must be a whole number from 0 to 9999.

endpoints.description: Returns sandbox spend, order counts, supplier totals, top products and an illustrative trend.
notes: Savings and trend figures are illustrative, not validated production analytics.

endpoints.description: Reads this sandbox workspace settings.
Changes only the supplied recognized settings.
notes: Boolean settings require booleans. daysCover is a whole number from 1 to 90.
deliveryCutoff uses HH:MM; theme is light or dark; fontSize is normal or large.
Unknown settings and unsupported test suppliers are rejected.
These settings do not turn on real ordering, AI or external notifications.

endpoints.description: Returns synthetic low-stock and delivery notifications.
Returns pending product, basket line and awaiting order counts.
Returns the fixed demo identity. Does not authenticate a production user.

catalogueIntegration.mode: Bundled indexed release snapshot; no external lookup credentials required
catalogueIntegration.identifierNotice: AMPP/VMPP identifiers are actual NHS decimal string codes. Legacy TARIFF hashes remain internal reference keys only.

routes.returns: data.packs for a current NHS pack
Validated reference product in workspace with separate simulated cost and shelf stock

catalogueIntegration.writes: Only browser workspace reference imports, basket, order and receipt state changes; no supplier or original-stock writes
catalogueIntegration.hosting: POST /api/dispatch carries id,workspace snapshot,logical method,path,data; preserves logical statuses and returned workspace
catalogueIntegration.security: No TRUD key in code, browser or deployment; no live supplier calls
